items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: So this guy, Benny Ross, who had a place to call it Robin Hood, he heard Paul and he hired Paul to come play at his place

ctx.x: On Louison Avenue. No, on Claiborne and Louison. Claiborne and around 3rd. Yeah. No, Claiborne and Louison Avenue. So Paul played with me and he started singing that number, I'm true, because I'm crazy over you. And everybody was crazy about him singing that thing. So this guy, Benny Ross, who had a place to call it Robin Hood, he heard Paul and he hired Paul to come play at his place and say I want you to get your own band. So Paul left my band to go to get his own band. And everybody was talking about the truth…
That was a big hit. Yeah. When you were working with Paul, who was, it was you and Paul and who else was in that band at The Hurricane? You said it was at the-
